turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My train got cancelled and I need to be at the airport by six.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, you have options. There's an airport bus in twenty minutes, or a taxi would get you there faster but cost a lot more. What do you want to do?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One sec, I'm going to talk with my neighbor. Please wait until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Look at these leaves. Do you think something's eating them?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, those holes look like slugs to me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great. What do your parents use against slugs?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: My mom puts crushed eggshells around the plants. Dad just goes out at night with a torch and picks them off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm not doing the torch thing. Eggshells I can manage.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: We have loads, I made an omelette yesterday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. We were sorting out your ride to the airport.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The bus. I've got enough time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good. It leaves from the stop outside the main entrance, so head there now.
